calab.description: Streaming calcium imaging from raw 1-photon Miniscope video
calab.longDescription: A streaming, in-browser pipeline that turns raw 1-photon Miniscope video into per-cell footprints and traces, frame by frame (Rust and WebAssembly, WebGPU later). It reads Miniscope AVI folders directly from disk, plays them back, and preprocesses and motion-corrects them live.
features: Reads Miniscope AVI folders in place, frame by frame
Never uploads or loads whole videos
Frame rate from timestamps and metadata, not the AVI header
Live preprocessing and rigid motion correction with a motion trace
